llm_response.reason: The website aggressively promises unrealistic returns on investments (up to 80%), uses urgency and psychological triggers, features vague or unverifiable testimonials, and lacks genuine company details. Payments are pushed via crypto, withdrawal promises are instant, and the listed contacts (Telegram only, no proper business info) are suspicious and not standard for financial operations. The privacy policy and terms are ambiguous, and the WHOIS lookup yields no verifiable registration data. These are all classic characteristics of an investment scam as outlined.
